requestVariables.typeHint: Any and Text both reach scripts as text. Any means no type was chosen; Text says the value is meant as text. Every type sends the value exactly as written; the type decides what scripts receive and which values are accepted.

problems.numberComma: {{name}} must be a number with a dot for decimals and no thousands separator, such as 1.5 or 1500.
problems.inexact: {{name}} is a number that a script cannot hold exactly. Use the Text type to keep it as written.
problems.jsonInexact: {{name}} contains the number {{number}}, which a script cannot hold exactly. Write it as a string in quotes.
